pairs.question: Et quae tanta fuit Romam tibi causa videndi?
pairs.answer: Libertas, quae sera tamen respexit inertem, candidior postquam tondenti barba cadebat, respexit tamen et longo post tempore venit, postquam nos Amaryllis habet, Galatea reliquit.
pairs.derivation: Meliboeus asks a clean interrogative (quae ... causa) for Tityrus's reason for seeing Rome. Tityrus answers directly: Libertas (freedom). Verse numbers 30 and the speaker labels Meliboeus/Tityrus are stripped. Answer ends at the first full stop after reliquit; the following line (namque - fatebor enim - dum me Galatea tenebat...) begins elaboration on his prior servitude and is cut.
